user_prompt: 用 ref2va 多模态参考生成这版雪夜拔刀戏
prompt_body:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is a shrine courtyard keyframe reference with snow coverage.
<Video 1> is the camera motion reference.
<Audio 1> is the ambient bed to reuse.
<Subject 1> is a weathered ronin in a dark kimono kneeling by the lantern.

summary: [reference generation] One continuous take of a ronin drawing his blade under falling snow in a shrine courtyard.

retention_analysis:

<Video 1> partially_preserved: pacing only, framing rebuilt.
<Audio 1> fully_copy: ambient bed kept intact.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic cinematic look, practical neon and lamp sources, shallow 35mm depth, natural skin texture.
[Shot 1] The camera holds the courtyard of <Picture 1> as <Subject 1> kneels stage left of the stone lantern, facing the torii gate along a locked 180-degree axis, snow settling on his shoulders.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, following the dolly pace of <Video 1>, <Subject 1> grips the tsuka with his right hand, thumbs the guard free with a soft click, and draws the blade in a rising arc; meltwater runs along the edge while the camera closes in.

overall_soundscape: Wind hum through the eaves, cloth rustle as weight shifts, the blade's thin ring as it clears the scabbard, snow faintly ticking off the lantern cap.

non_diegetic_music: none, diegetic ambience carries the whole scene.
